heading: 女誡 Nü Jie · Ban Zhao · 女誡 序 … 和叔妹

items.text: Serve your husband with upright conduct and a pure heart.
items.quote: 正色端操，以事夫主 — Serve your husband with upright conduct and a pure heart.

items.text: Prepare clean food and drink to offer to the ancestors.
items.quote: 絜齊酒食，以供祖宗 — Prepare clean food and drink to offer to the ancestors.
items.conflict: Ancestor offerings are idolatry; the dead cannot be served (Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: Rise early and retire late; work diligently at household tasks without complaining.
items.quote: 晚寢早作，勿憚夙夜，執務私事，不辭劇易 — Rise early and retire late; do not shrink from hard work in household affairs.

items.text: Be worthy and govern your wife.
items.quote: 夫不賢，則無以御婦 — If a husband is not worthy, he cannot govern his wife.

items.text: Be respectful and submissive to your husband; do not contend with him.
items.quote: 修身莫若敬，避彊莫若順 — For cultivating oneself, nothing is better than respect; for avoiding strife, nothing is better than obedience.

items.text: Speak only what is fitting; avoid offensive words.
items.quote: 擇辭而說，不道惡語，時然後言，不厭於人 — Choose your words before speaking; do not utter evil speech; speak at the right time and do not weary others.

items.text: Remain faithful to your husband even after his death; do not remarry.
items.quote: 夫有再娶之義，婦無二適之文 — A husband may remarry; a wife may not marry again.
items.conflict: Scripture permits remarriage for widows (Rom 7:2-3; 1 Cor 7:39) and rejects such double standards.

items.text: Seek your husband's heart by wholehearted devotion and correct demeanor, not by flattery.
items.quote: 夫不可不求其心。然所求者，亦非謂佞媚苟親也，固莫若專心正色 — You must seek your husband's heart. But this seeking is not flattery or cheap intimacy; nothing is better than wholehearted devotion and correct demeanor.

items.text: Be modest, avoid seductive appearance, do not gather with groups, and do not stare at the door.
items.quote: 出無冶容，入無廢飾，無聚會羣輩，無看視門戶 — When going out, do not wear seductive makeup; when at home, do not neglect your dress; do not gather with groups; do not stare at the door.

items.text: Obey your parents-in-law absolutely, even when they are wrong; do not argue.
items.quote: 姑云不爾而是，固宜從令；姑云爾而非，猶宜順命 — If your mother-in-law says no though it is right, obey; if she says yes though it is wrong, still obey.
items.conflict: God must be obeyed rather than men (Acts 5:29); no human authority may command sin or override conscience.

items.text: Be humble and yielding toward your husband's siblings to win their favor.
items.quote: 然則求叔妹之心，固莫尚於謙順矣 — Therefore, to seek the hearts of your husband's siblings, nothing is better than humility and obedience.
